verdicts.reason: Both have the same faults: the 'Find a Store' CTA is a tiny pill crammed into the top-left corner above the product, so the reading order runs backwards. The CITRINE logo is blown up into a huge wordmark that competes with the headline, and 'fizz' sits alone on its own line. A is slightly worse because its CTA nearly touches the left and top edges and 'Garden-fresh' runs almost edge to edge. B leaves a little more margin around both.
